title: Cylinder 1 Injector Circuit Intermittent
shortDescription: PCM detected: cylinder 1 injector circuit intermittent.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates cylinder 1 injector circuit intermittent. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Engine may misfire; avoid prolonged hard driving.

causes.cause: Wiring or connector issue at injector

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect fuel injector wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect fuel injector and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; expect rough running.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

shortDescription: PCM detected: torque converter/brake switch b circuit.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates torque converter/brake switch b circuit. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Transmission may enter limp mode; avoid extended driving.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect TCM/PCM circuit wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect TCM/PCM circuit and clear codes.

faq.a: Drive cautiously to a shop; expect limp mode.
No - the fault must be diagnosed and repaired.
